configuration.query_membership: first 25 lines of calibration-500.tsv in preserved order

declared_changes.measurement: Add matched resident-query timing to prior correctness-only protocol.
declared_changes.resident_context: Hoist deterministic numeric-ID validation and zero-completion ordering from each search invocation into per-index setup; preserve search loop and scoring semantics.
declared_changes.instrumentation: Add runtime-gated Rust benchmark adapter; no external search commands treated as instrumented without the adapter.

analysis_plan: Every warmup and measured top-10 must equal the saved 1M oracle before any latency interpretation; analyze all fixed paired rounds and retain raw samples.
failure_rule: Any output mismatch, runtime drift, failed command, or missing/duplicate sample blocks timing interpretation. Preserve partial evidence and separately review corrections before retry.
reuse: Reuse hash-validated parent index blobs and effective query/oracle files. Rebuild Rust library and binaries after the reviewed resident-context overlay; do not reuse prior search binary for new measurements.

execution.stopping_rule: Complete exact input checks, CPU reference and both 25-query layouts; preserve any timeout/failure.

measurement.order: query order fixed; raw/compressed order alternates by (round+query_index)%2
measurement.cpu_affinity: one allowed logical CPU, frozen after CIMS preflight
measurement.boundary: resident index: cursor creation from preloaded effective PISA text, query preparation, bounds, candidate scheduling, scoring, top-k and ordered TREC string construction
measurement.excluded: index load, numeric-ID validation/zero-order setup, query file I/O, runtime gate, output file I/O, monitoring, correctness analysis
measurement.cache_policy: both indexes resident; repeated calibration workload; no cache flushing
measurement.statistic: geometric mean across query-wise ratios of compressed median / raw median; lower is faster
measurement.confidence: 95% percentile bootstrap across 25 query pairs, 10000 resamples, seed 20261111; exploratory calibration scope
measurement.stopping: fixed rounds; preserve partial output on failure; no optional stopping
measurement.monitoring: CPU affinity, /proc/stat and load/frequency snapshots outside each round; shared-host contention remains a limit
